comment: Maps a unit's path (relative to .ai/, posix form) to the schema that validates its frontmatter. First matching glob wins. Files WITHOUT a YAML frontmatter block are not units and are skipped regardless of glob. guardrails/core.md is the Tier G container (validated against base) until M3 resolves the guardrail rule-granularity open question — see milestones/M1-schema-and-skeleton.md.
